# ArcadeX SDK — Developer Documentation

> ArcadeX is a multi-chain Web3 gaming platform. This SDK lets any web-based game
> (Unity WebGL, Godot HTML5, Phaser 3, or plain HTML/JS) submit on-chain scores,
> reward players with tokens, and sell NFT skins / power-ups — with only a few
> lines of code. Games run inside an ArcadeX iframe and talk to the platform over
> `window.postMessage`; the platform handles all wallet and blockchain work.

- SDK version: v4.0.0 (Unity edition: v2.0.0)
- Supported chains: BOTChain EVM and MST Blockchain (multi-chain)
- Docs page: https://www.playarcadex.in/sdk
- This file: https://www.playarcadex.in/llms.txt

## How It Works

The SDK is a thin messaging bridge. Your game never touches wallets, private keys,
or contracts directly — it just emits events:

1. Your game calls `ArcadeSDK.gameOver(score)` when the player finishes.
2. `arcade-sdk.js` sends a `postMessage` event to the parent window.
3. The ArcadeX platform receives the event and triggers the blockchain transaction
   (score validation, signing, on-chain submission).
4. The chain saves the score and mints reward tokens.

Reward split per play: 80% of tokens go to the player, 20% to the game's creator.

Scores are validated and signed server-side before they are written on-chain, so a
game cannot submit an arbitrary score directly — the platform is the source of truth.

## SDK Files

Pick the file that matches your engine. All files are downloadable from the
Overview section of the docs page.

- `arcade-sdk.js` (v4.0.0) — Core SDK. Works with any web-based game engine / plain HTML.
- `arcade-sdk-unity.js` (v2.0.0) — Unity WebGL edition. Exposes globals the C# bridge calls. Place in the WebGL `Build/` folder.
- `arcade-sdk-godot.js` (v4.0.0) — Godot 3.x / 4.x HTML5 export edition.
- `arcade-sdk-phaser.js` (v4.0.0) — Phaser 3 edition. Global API plus an optional Scene Plugin (`this.arcade`).
- `ArcadeBridge.jslib` — Unity C# ↔ JavaScript bridge (`DllImport`). Place in `Assets/Plugins/WebGL/`.

Place the SDK file in the same folder as your `index.html` and load it with a
`<script>` tag before your game code.

## Quick Start

From zero to an integrated game in under 10 minutes:

1. Build your game and export as WebGL / HTML5.
2. Add `arcade-sdk.js` next to your `index.html`.
3. Add three lines of code: `init`, `updateScore`, `gameOver`.
4. Deploy (e.g. Vercel) and submit your game URL on ArcadeX.

Minimal integration:

```html
<!-- 1. Add the SDK to your index.html -->
<script src="arcade-sdk.js"></script>
<script>
  // 2. Initialize once when the game loads
  ArcadeSDK.init("YOUR_GAME_ID");   // use "" on your first deploy

  // 3. Send live score updates (UI only, no transaction)
  ArcadeSDK.updateScore(1500);

  // 4. Submit the final score on-chain when the game ends
  ArcadeSDK.gameOver(9999);
</script>
```

`updateScore()` only updates the ArcadeX UI and never triggers a transaction, so it
is safe to call frequently. `gameOver()` is the only call that writes on-chain.

## Core API Reference

`ArcadeSDK.init(gameId, options)`
Initialize the SDK. Call once when the game loads.
- `gameId` (string) — Your Game ID from the Creator Dashboard. Pass `""` on first deploy.
- `options.gameName` (string) — Display name shown on the platform.
- `options.debug` (boolean) — Enable verbose console logging.

`ArcadeSDK.updateScore(score)`
Send the real-time score to the ArcadeX UI. Does NOT trigger a blockchain tx. Call frequently.
- `score` (number) — Current player score.

`ArcadeSDK.gameOver(finalScore)`
Submit the final score on-chain. Triggers a blockchain tx. 80% tokens to player, 20% to creator.
- `finalScore` (number) — Player's final score.

`ArcadeSDK.purchaseSkin(skinIndex, name, pinataCID, price)`
Pay + mint an ERC-1155 NFT for a permanent skin/character in a single call. No
pre-registration — pass everything the game already knows about the skin.
- `skinIndex` (number) — Unique index for this skin (0, 1, 2...).
- `name` (string) — Display name, e.g. "Batman".
- `pinataCID` (string) — IPFS CID (with or without the `ipfs://` prefix).
- `price` (number) — Price in ARCADE/MSTC, whole tokens.

`ArcadeSDK.purchasePowerUp(powerUpId, price)`
Pay only, no NFT minted. Ownership/unlock state stays entirely on your game side.
- `powerUpId` (string) — Unique identifier, e.g. "SCALE_BOOST".
- `price` (number) — Price in ARCADE/MSTC, whole tokens.

`ArcadeSDK.recordGameTime(seconds)`
Log playtime for this session (off-chain, Firestore only).
- `seconds` (number) — Seconds played this session.

`ArcadeSDK.recordEvent(eventType, value)`
Log a custom gameplay event (kill, win, level_up, etc.) off-chain.
- `eventType` (string) — Event name.
- `value` (number) — Event value, defaults to 1.

`ArcadeSDK.getPlayerProfile()`
Request the connected player's wallet info. Returns via the `PLAYER_INFO` event.

Other helpers: `ArcadeSDK.pause()`, `ArcadeSDK.resume()`, `ArcadeSDK.getScore()`.

## Events (platform → game)

Your game receives these via `window.postMessage`. Listen with
`window.addEventListener("message", handler)`.

```js
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const { type, data } = event.data;
  switch (type) {
    case "PLAYER_INFO":         // wallet connected: data.address, data.balance
    case "TRANSACTION_SUCCESS": // score on-chain: data.txHash
    case "TRANSACTION_FAILED":  // tx failed: data.error
    case "PURCHASE_SUCCESS":    // skin/powerup confirmed: data.kind, data.tokenId, data.txHash
    case "PURCHASE_FAILED":     // purchase failed/rejected: data.kind, data.error
      break;
  }
});
```

Event reference:

- `PLAYER_INFO` — Sent when player info is requested. `data.address` (EVM wallet address), `data.balance` (token balance).
- `TRANSACTION_SUCCESS` — Score successfully submitted on-chain. `data.txHash`.
- `TRANSACTION_FAILED` — Blockchain transaction failed. `data.error`.
- `PURCHASE_SUCCESS` — Skin or power-up purchase confirmed. `data.kind` ("skin" | "powerup"), `data.skinIndex` (skin only), `data.powerUpId` (power-up only), `data.tokenId` (minted NFT, skin only), `data.txHash`.
- `PURCHASE_FAILED` — Skin or power-up purchase failed or was rejected. `data.kind`, `data.error`.

Note: some engine editions also expose callback hooks instead of raw events, e.g.
`ArcadeSDK.onSuccess`, `onError`, `onPurchaseSuccess`, `onPurchaseFailed`, `onPlayerInfo`.

## Integration — Unity WebGL

Use `arcade-sdk-unity.js` + `ArcadeBridge.jslib`. The `.jslib` exposes C# extern
methods (`arcade_init`, `arcade_updateScore`, `arcade_gameOver`, etc.) that call the
JS SDK. Incoming events are delivered to a GameObject named exactly `ArcadeManager`
via Unity's `SendMessage` (`OnTransactionSuccess`, `OnTransactionFailed`,
`OnPlayerInfoReceived`).

Setup:
1. Put `arcade-sdk-unity.js` in the WebGL `Build/` folder (next to `index.html`) and load it with a `<script>` tag.
2. Put `ArcadeBridge.jslib` in `Assets/Plugins/WebGL/`.
3. Create a GameObject named `ArcadeManager` and attach a manager script that declares the `DllImport` externs and receives the callbacks.

C# extern declarations (WebGL only):

```csharp
[DllImport("__Internal")] private static extern void arcade_init(string gameId);
[DllImport("__Internal")] private static extern void arcade_updateScore(int score);
[DllImport("__Internal")] private static extern void arcade_gameOver(int finalScore);
[DllImport("__Internal")] private static extern void arcade_getPlayerProfile();

void Start()  { arcade_init("YOUR_GAME_ID"); }
void OnEnd(int s) { arcade_gameOver(s); }

// Called back by the SDK on the "ArcadeManager" GameObject:
public void OnTransactionSuccess(string txHash) { /* score saved */ }
public void OnTransactionFailed(string error)   { /* handle failure */ }
public void OnPlayerInfoReceived(string json)   { /* {address, balance} */ }
```

## Integration — Godot HTML5

Use `arcade-sdk-godot.js`. In the Godot export `index.html`, add before `</head>`:

```html
<script src="arcade-sdk-godot.js"></script>
```

Godot 3.x (GDScript, via `JavaScript.eval`):

```gdscript
func _ready():
    if OS.has_feature("JavaScript"):
        JavaScript.eval("ArcadeSDK.init('YOUR_GAME_ID')")

func game_over(final_score: int):
    if OS.has_feature("JavaScript"):
        JavaScript.eval("ArcadeSDK.gameOver(" + str(final_score) + ")")
```

Godot 4.x — replace `JavaScript.eval()` with `JavaScriptBridge.eval()` and
`OS.has_feature("JavaScript")` with `OS.has_feature("web")`.

## Integration — Phaser 3

Use `arcade-sdk-phaser.js`. Two styles are available.

Global (simple):

```js
ArcadeSDK.init("YOUR_GAME_ID");
ArcadeSDK.updateScore(this.score);
ArcadeSDK.gameOver(this.score);
```

Scene Plugin (advanced) — the SDK registers itself as `this.arcade` inside any Scene:

```js
class GameScene extends Phaser.Scene {
  create() { this.arcade.init("YOUR_GAME_ID"); }
  update() { if (this.score % 100 === 0) this.arcade.updateScore(this.score); }
  onGameOver() {
    this.arcade.gameOver(this.score);
    ArcadeSDK.onSuccess = (txHash) => console.log("saved:", txHash);
    ArcadeSDK.onError   = (err)    => console.error(err);
  }
}
```

## Integration — Plain HTML / JS

Use `arcade-sdk.js` — works with any web game or engine:

```html
<script src="arcade-sdk.js"></script>
<script>
  ArcadeSDK.init("YOUR_GAME_ID", { debug: true });
  // ... run your game, then on game end:
  ArcadeSDK.gameOver(finalScore);
  ArcadeSDK.onSuccess = (txHash) => console.log("On-chain:", txHash);
  ArcadeSDK.onError   = (err)    => console.error("Failed:", err);
</script>
```

To read the connected wallet, call `ArcadeSDK.getPlayerProfile()` and handle the
`PLAYER_INFO` event (or set `ArcadeSDK.onPlayerInfo`).

## FAQ

What Game ID do I use on first deploy?
Leave it empty (`""`). After an admin approves your game you get a Game ID; update
it in your code and redeploy (Vercel auto-redeploys in ~30s).

Does the player need to connect a wallet?
Yes — players connect MetaMask or a compatible wallet on a supported ArcadeX chain
(BOTChain or MST Blockchain) to earn tokens. The Connect Wallet button is in the
ArcadeX navbar.

My game is in an iframe, will postMessage work?
Yes. ArcadeX embeds your game in an iframe and the SDK uses
`window.parent.postMessage` to communicate with the platform.

Can I test locally without deploying?
Yes — use the "Simulate Game Over" button on the gameplay page, or the Debug panel
(🐛) to test score submission.

What happens if the transaction fails?
Your game receives a `TRANSACTION_FAILED` event. The score is NOT saved on-chain.
Show the player an error or offer a retry.

How do I get my Game ID?
Submit your game at `/publish` on ArcadeX. After admin approval (usually within 24
hours) your Game ID appears in your Creator Dashboard.
